title: LIGHT BLOOD: PILLAGERS AND PLAYERS
why: His answer 37 a: light blood, only from pillager bots and players. A pillager hit by a round and a player taking damage now bleed a little: a few dark red droplets, a short red mist and now and then a small drop on the ground that fades away. Machines never bleed: a round on a machine throws the same yellow sparks as before. It is light on purpose, a few pixels and never a pool, and it is only a picture: nothing about the fight changes.
now: Pillagers and players now bleed a little when hit; machines throw sparks as before.
